preprocessing.comment: Green channel only (see preprocessing.py). Percentile stretch is mild and FOV-restricted.

enhancement.comment: White top-hat on inverted green at multiple disk scales; max-projection. Scales cover ~2-10px wide vessels at 565x584.

segmentation.comment: Percentile threshold inside FOV: response above this percentile -> vessel. Starting point 89 ~= 100 - 11% vessel fraction observed on image 21.

postprocessing.comment: Conservative: drop tiny components only (thin vessels preserved); optional 3x3 closing.
